# Every screen

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from lib/kb/articles.ts, lib/nav.ts, lib/pageHelp.ts and lib/glossary.ts. Do not edit by hand: change the source and run `npm run docs`. -->

All 131 screens the menus and the help know about, grouped as in the **Advanced** menu. "Simple menu" shows the name a screen has in the shorter everyday menu. To open any of them, press **Ctrl+K** and type its name or its QuickBooks name.

## Home

| Screen | Path | QuickBooks name | What it is for | First step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Home | `/dashboard` | Home page | Your starting point: "Needs attention" lists what is waiting on you, most urgent first; "Overview" shows how money moves, and you click any step to do it. | Work down Needs attention, or on Overview pick a task such as Create Invoices or Pay Bills. |
| Needs attention | `/attention` | Company Snapshot alerts | Everything waiting on you, most urgent first: bank transactions to sort, late customers, bills due, reconciling, payroll taxes, to-dos and backups. | Use the button on each line (Sort it, Send reminder, Pay, Done). Not now? Choose Later to snooze or dismiss it. |
| Agent requests | `/agent-requests` |  | On its own an agent does only what its settings allow, usually looking and drafting; what it must ask for waits here, showing the change. The Audit Trail and Agent Activity report keep the record. | Approve once, Approve similar… (standing permission) or Deny. Whoever manages users can pause an agent; an Admin can pause all. |
| To Do list | `/todos` | To Do List | Calls, emails, meetings and tasks you want to remember, optionally about a customer, vendor, employee or lead. They also show on the Calendar and in Reminders. | Click "New to-do", describe it and pick a due date. |

## Sales

| Screen | Path | QuickBooks name | What it is for | First step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Invoices (Simple menu: Create Invoice) | `/invoices` | Create Invoices | Bill a customer who will pay you later. Saving an invoice records the sale and what the customer owes you. | Click "New invoice", pick the customer, add what you sold and save. |
| Sales Receipts | `/sales-receipts` | Enter Sales Receipts | Record a sale that was paid on the spot (cash, card or check), so no invoice is needed. | Click "New sales receipt", pick the customer, add what you sold and how they paid. |
| Estimates | `/estimates` | Create Estimates | A price quote for a customer. It does not change your books until you turn it into an invoice. | Click "New estimate", add the work or items, then send it to the customer. |
| Sales Orders | `/sales-orders` | Create Sales Orders | Track an order a customer placed that you will deliver and invoice later. It does not change your books by itself. | Click "New sales order", add the items, and invoice it when you ship. |
| Sales order fulfillment | `/so-fulfillment` | Sales Order Fulfillment Worksheet (SO Fulfillment) | See which open sales orders you can ship now with the stock on hand. | Tick the orders to fill, then print pick lists or create the invoices. |
| Receive Payments (Simple menu: Receive Payment) | `/payments` | Receive Payments | Record money a customer paid you against their invoices, so their balance goes down. | Pick the customer, enter the amount, and tick the invoices it pays. |
| Credit Memos | `/credit-memos` | Create Credit Memos/Refunds | Give a customer a credit (for a return or a mistake) that lowers what they owe, or refund them. | Click "New credit memo", pick the customer and add what you are crediting. Prices follow the price level set on the customer. |
| Customers | `/customers` | Customer Center | Everyone you sell to, with their contact details, balance owed and history. | Click "New customer" to add one, or click a name to see what they owe. |
| Leads | `/leads` | Lead Center | People who might become customers. Track calls and to-dos, then turn a lead into a customer in one click. | Add a lead, then add a to-do to follow up. |
| Late-payment charges | `/finance-charges` | Assess Finance Charges | Add interest or a late fee to customers whose invoices are overdue. | Check the rate and grace period, review the list, then assess the charges you want. |
| Money coming in | `/income-tracker` | Income Tracker | One view of estimates, unbilled orders, unbilled time and costs, open and overdue invoices, and money paid in the last 30 days. | Click a coloured bar to see those transactions; use a row’s action to receive a payment or bill time and costs. |
| Collect overdue payments | `/collections-center` | Collections Center | Customers who are late paying, with how much and how late, so you can follow up. | On a customer, log a call, email the overdue invoices or a statement, print a collection letter, or receive a payment. |
| Invoice many customers | `/invoices/batch` | Batch Invoicing | Send the same charge (for example a monthly fee) to a group of customers in one go. | Pick the customers (or a saved Billing Group), add the items once, then create the invoices. |
| Items | `/items` | Item List | The products and services you buy and sell. Each item knows its price and which account it goes to. | Click "New item" and add the things you sell most. |
| Sales Reps | `/sales-reps` | Sales Rep List | The people credited with sales, so reports can show sales by rep. | Add each rep once, then pick them on invoices. |
| Pricing rules | `/advanced-pricing` | Advanced Pricing | Automatic price changes, for example 10% off for a customer group or a sale price for a date range. | Click "New rule", choose who and what it applies to, and the price change. |

## Purchases

| Screen | Path | QuickBooks name | What it is for | First step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Purchase Orders | `/purchase-orders` | Create Purchase Orders | An order you send a vendor. It does not change your books until the items arrive or the bill comes. | Click "New purchase order", pick the vendor and the items you are ordering. |
| Receive Items | `/item-receipts` | Receive Items | Record items that arrived before the bill, so your stock is right. | Pick the vendor and the purchase order, then enter what arrived. |
| Bill for received items | `/receive-bill` | Enter Bill for Received Items | When the bill comes for items you already received, turn that receipt into a bill. | Pick the vendor and the item receipt, check the amounts and save. |
| Enter Bills (Simple menu: Enter Bill) | `/bills` | Enter Bills | Record a bill you received and will pay later, so you know what you owe each vendor. | Click "New bill", pick the vendor, the amount and what it was for. |
| Pay Bills | `/pay-bills` | Pay Bills | Pay the bills you already entered. Each payment lowers what you owe the vendor. | Tick the bills to pay, choose the bank account and payment date, then pay. |
| Write Checks (Simple menu: Write Check) | `/expenses` | Write Checks | Record money you paid right away by check, debit card or cash, and what it was for. | Click "New check", pick the bank account, the payee and the expense. The payee can be a vendor or someone on the Other Names list. |
| Receipts | `/receipts` | Doc Center (receipts) | Photos and PDFs of receipts waiting to be entered. Ironbooks reads them on this computer and fills in a new expense or bill for you to check. | Drag a receipt anywhere in the app, or click Add receipts or Send from your phone. |
| Vendor Credits | `/vendor-credits` | Enter Credit from Vendor | A credit from a vendor (for a return or overcharge) that lowers what you owe them. | Click "New vendor credit", pick the vendor and the amount; use it when you pay bills. |
| Pay Sales Tax | `/sales-tax` | Pay Sales Tax | See the sales tax you collected and owe each tax agency, and pay it. | Pick the bank account and the "show tax due through" date, tick the agencies to pay, then pay. |
| Print Checks | `/print-checks` | Print Checks | Print the checks you marked "to be printed" on your check stock. | Pick the bank account and starting check number, then print. Answer "Did checks print OK?" to record check numbers. |
| Vendors | `/vendors` | Vendor Center | Everyone you buy from, with their details, balance you owe and history. | Click "New vendor" to add one, or click a name to see open bills. |

## Banking

| Screen | Path | QuickBooks name | What it is for | First step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bank accounts | `/banking` | Banking | Your bank and credit card accounts with their balances. | Click an account to see its transactions, or add a new account. |
| Registers | `/registers` | Use Register (Check Register) | Every transaction in one account, like a checkbook, with a running balance. | Pick an account to open its register. |
| Bank Feeds (Simple menu: Bank Feeds / Import) | `/bank-feeds` | Bank Feeds | Bring in transactions from statement files your bank gives you, so you do not type them. | Import the file from your bank, then review each line. |
| Review bank transactions | `/bank-review` | Bank Feeds Center (review) | Match each imported bank line to a transaction you entered, or add it. | Work down the list: confirm the suggested match or choose a category. |
| Bank rules | `/bank-rules` | Bank Feeds Rules | Rules tell the app which account to use for bank lines that look alike, such as every SHELL OIL charge going to Fuel. It also offers rules when you repeat a choice. | Click "New rule", say what the bank line contains and which account it goes to, then test it. |
| Make Deposits (Simple menu: Make Deposit) | `/deposits` | Make Deposits | Group customer payments you took to the bank into one deposit, so it matches your bank statement. | Tick the payments you deposited, choose the bank account and save. |
| Reconcile | `/reconcile` | Reconcile | Check your books against your bank statement so you know every transaction is right. | Pick the account, enter the statement date and ending balance, then tick what cleared. |
| Transfer Funds | `/transfers` | Transfer Funds | Move money between your own accounts, for example checking to savings. | Pick the from and to accounts and the amount. |
| Loans | `/loans` | Loan Manager | Track loans you owe, their payments and how much is interest. The balance owed is read from the loan account; "What if" compares another rate, payment or term, a lump sum or extra principal. | Add a loan with its amount, rate and term (tick "already being paid" if you have been paying it). Then set up each payment. |
| Enter many transactions | `/accountant/batch-enter` | Batch Enter Transactions | Type or paste lots of checks, deposits, card charges, bills, invoices or journal entries in one spreadsheet-style grid. Each row is checked as you go and saved as its own transaction. | Pick the transaction type, then type rows or paste them from Excel or Google Sheets. Fix rows marked red, then save. |

## Accounting

| Screen | Path | QuickBooks name | What it is for | First step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Journal entries | `/journal` | Make General Journal Entries | Move amounts between accounts directly. Mostly used by accountants for adjustments. | Ask your accountant before using it; debits must equal credits. |
| Chart of Accounts | `/accounts` | Chart of Accounts | The categories your money is sorted into: bank accounts, income, expenses, what you own and owe. | Look through the list; add an account only when you need a new category. |
| Pay payroll taxes | `/pay-liabilities` | Pay Payroll Liabilities | Send the payroll taxes you withheld and owe to the government. | Pick the date range, tick what you are paying and choose the bank account. |
| Employees & payroll | `/employees` | Employee Center / Payroll | Your employees, their pay rates and tax settings. | Add each employee, then run payroll. |
| Payroll Setup | `/employees/setup` | Payroll Setup |  |  |
| Run payroll (Simple menu: Run Payroll) | `/pay-runs` | Pay Employees | Pay your employees: work out each paycheck, the taxes withheld and what you owe the government. | Pick the pay period and employees, check the paychecks, then create them. |
| Pay Stubs | `/pay-stubs` | Pay Stubs |  |  |
| Payroll Forms | `/payroll-forms` | Process Payroll Forms |  |  |
| Payroll Tax | `/payroll-tax` | Payroll Tax |  |  |
| Classes & locations | `/tracking` | Class List / Tracking |  |  |
| Sales tax items | `/sales-tax-components` | Sales Tax Items / Components | The sales tax rates you charge and the tax agency each one is paid to. Inactive items stay on old sales but are not offered on new ones. | Click "New sales tax item", give it a name and a rate, and pick (or add) its tax agency. |
| Recurring transactions | `/recurring` | Memorized Transactions | Transactions you enter again and again (rent, subscriptions), saved so they repeat on schedule or with one click. | Save a transaction as recurring from its form, then set how often. |
| Currencies | `/currencies` | Currency List |  |  |
| Fiscal Periods | `/fiscal-periods` | Fiscal Periods |  |  |
| Year-End Close | `/year-end` | Set Closing Date |  |  |

Open one here to change or export it. |

## Setup

| Screen | Path | QuickBooks name | What it is for | First step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Companies | `/companies` | Open or Restore Company |  |  |
| Company File | `/company-file` | Back Up Company |  |  |
| Back Up & Restore | `/backup` | Back Up Company / Restore Previous Local Backup | Keeps safe copies of your company file, automatically on a schedule and whenever you ask. Look inside any copy before you restore it. | Check the automatic backup schedule, then click "Back up now" to make a copy today. |
| Try it on a copy | `/sandbox` | Sandbox / practice file | Opens a throwaway copy of your whole company file so you can practice or test a change. Emails, bank feeds and automatic backups are off there. | Click "Try it on a copy". When done, discard the copy or keep it as a training file. |
| Period Copy | `/accountant/period-copy` | Period Copy | A separate copy of your company file that shows only one period, for an auditor: opening balances for everything before it and nothing after it. Your own file is not changed. | Pick the first and last day of the period and click "Create Period Copy". |
| Users & Roles | `/users` | Set Up Users and Roles | Who can sign in to this company file and what each person may do. A role sets access per activity, such as Invoices or Receive Payments. | Add a user and give them one or more roles, or clone a built-in role to make your own. |
| View Permissions | `/users/permissions` | Users and Roles > View Permissions | Reports of what each role or user may do in every area and activity, side by side, plus the user and role lists. | Pick a report, tick the roles or users to compare, then print it or download it as CSV. |
| Migrate from QuickBooks | `/qb-import` | Import IIF / Convert |  |  |
| Security (2FA) | `/security` | Security | Protects the company file with its own passwords: it is encrypted, and only its user names and passwords (or its recovery key) open it, on any computer. | An Admin clicks "Protect This Company File with Passwords", then prints or saves the recovery key. |
| Change My Password | `/change-password` | Change Your Password | Choose a new password for signing in, following the password rules an Admin set under Users & Roles. When your password expires, you come here first. | Type your current password, then the new one twice, and click Change password. |
| Privacy & Network | `/privacy` | Privacy |  |  |
| Multi-user | `/multi-user` | Multi-user mode |  |  |
| Preferences | `/settings` | Edit > Preferences | Settings for the whole company and just for you, such as features you use, the menu style and the mail server that sends your forms (Send Forms). | Open a category on the left, change what you need and save. Each category has a My Preferences and a Company Preferences tab. |
| My Preferences | `/my-preferences` | Edit > Preferences > My Preferences | Your own settings, open to every user: the name and email address your forms are sent from, Bcc me, menus and more. | Pick a category on the left, change what you need and save. Only you are affected. |
| System Accounts | `/system-accounts` | Accounts Ironbooks posts to (A/P, Inventory, COGS, Sales Tax, Payroll) | The accounts Ironbooks posts to on its own: Accounts Payable, Inventory, Cost of Goods Sold, Sales Tax and Payroll Liabilities. A converted QuickBooks file may number them differently. | Check the account each line posts to. If one is wrong, choose the right account and click Save. |
| Setup Interview | `/onboarding` | EasyStep Interview | Answer a few questions about your company and the app turns on only the features you use. | Fill in your company details, pick your tax form, then choose the features. You can skip any time. |
| Document Numbers | `/doc-numbers` | Document numbering |  |  |
| Form Templates | `/templates` | Templates / Layout Designer |  |  |
| AI & Automation | `/ai-settings` | AI settings |  |  |

## Other screens (not in the menu)

| Screen | Path | QuickBooks name | What it is for | First step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| What's behind this number | `/reports/drilldown` | QuickZoom | Every transaction that adds up to the amount you clicked on a report, using the same dates, basis and filters as the report. | Click a date to open that transaction and its original document; use Back to return to the report where you left it. |
| Sign in | `/login` | QuickBooks Desktop Login | Opens the company file with your user name and password. A protected company file is unlocked on this computer by this same sign-in. | Type your password and press Enter. Forgot it? Choose "I forgot my password", or use the recovery key. |
| Budgets | `/budgets` |  |  |  |
| Transactions | `/transactions` |  |  |  |
| Help & Glossary | `/help` |  | Plain-language guides for common tasks and a glossary of accounting terms. | Type what you want to do in the search box. |
